column1: # Why BARCS and the paper part ways, one row per reanalysis labelled partial or differ.
# DRAFT: written from the agent-written verdicts in reanalyses/<GSE>/meta.json, not from the counts.
# Every row needs a manual check (fill checked_by) before any number from this file goes into the paper.
# reason / also (secondary) vocabulary, grouped by family:
#   less_certain:     few_replicates (1 library per arm or too few residual df), weak_screen (shallow or weakly
#                     selected; nothing passes for anyone), replicate_variance (large animal/tumour spread)
#   evidence_against: calibration (controls inflated, too few or absent), bottleneck_jackpots (clonal takeover,
#                     sampling dropout, single-guide jackpots), hit_not_robust (rests on few guides or replicates
#                     disagree), not_condition_specific (general fitness effect, not specific to the contrast),
#                     lenient_paper_threshold (paper's list near what chance gives), some_hits_unsupported (some
#                     named genes recovered, others not supported by the counts)
#   not_comparable:   beyond_model (genetic interactions, CRISPRa tiling, mixed models), paper_evidence_elsewhere
#                     (the paper's claim rests on other assays or screens)
